The task was univariate, two-week-ahead regression: information observed at forecast origin t was used to predict the weekly dengue case count at t + 2. The study evaluated predictive accuracy rather than causal effects. No individual-level or personally identifiable health records were analyzed. 2.2 Data Sources and Eligibility The unified dataset combined two surveillance sources. Department of Health-Epidemiology Bureau records were filtered to retain only Marikina City observations from 2016–2020 [2]. More recent weekly records for 2023–2025 were obtained from the Marikina Epidemiology Surveillance Unit (MESU). The 2025 holdout included 15 low, 14 moderate, 16 high, and seven very high or outbreak-level weeks, providing a broader test than a partial-year holdout. papers.abstract_original: Background Short-horizon dengue forecasting can support local preparedness, but model comparisons may be weakened by random splitting, information leakage, limited baseline testing, and insufficient out-of-time evaluation. This study developed a surveillance-only framework for forecasting weekly dengue incidence in Marikina City two weeks ahead. Methods Weekly records combined Marikina-filtered Department of Health–Epidemiology Bureau data from 2016–2020 with Marikina Epidemiology Surveillance Unit data from 2023–2025. The years 2021–2022 were excluded because the available records contained zero and three reported cases, respectively. Eight trained models—ARIMA, SARIMA, ETS, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, LSTM, and Temporal CNN—were compared with naïve and moving-average reference baselines. Target-year splits used 2024 for internal validation and model selection and 2025 as an out-of-time temporal holdout. Earlier observed 2025 case counts were permitted as causal inputs for forecasting later 2025 targets when they occurred before the relevant forecast origin. Mean absolute error was the primary metric, supported by root mean square error, coefficient of determination, feature importance, and incidence-class error analysis. Results The cleaned dataset contained 417 weekly observations and 8,263 reported cases. ARIMA was the strongest trained model during 2024 internal validation, although the two-week moving average and naïve baselines produced slightly lower errors. In the 2025 temporal holdout, LSTM achieved the most favorable metrics, with an MAE of 7.951, RMSE of 10.651, and R2 of 0.698, followed by ARIMA with an MAE of 8.652, RMSE of 11.686, and R2 of 0.636. Both achieved lower MAE than the naïve baseline. Tree-based models relied primarily on current incidence and two-week rolling summaries. All evaluated methods tended to underpredict outbreak-level weeks. Conclusions Surveillance-only forecasting was feasible under a leakage-safe temporal design. LSTM produced the strongest 2025 holdout metrics, while ARIMA remained an interpretable and computationally efficient alternative. Operational use should retain simple baselines, communicate uncertainty, and prioritize improved detection of rapid outbreak escalation.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 短期登革热预报可以支持当地的准备工作,但模型比较可能会因随机分裂、信息泄漏、有限的基线测试和不充分的过时评估而受到削弱。这项研究开发了一个仅 监测 的框架,用于预测马里基纳市未来两周的每周登革热 监测。方法 每周记录将 2016-2020 年经马里基纳过滤的卫生部 –流行病学 局数据与 2023-2025 年马里基纳 流行病学 监测 单位数据相结合。2021-2022 年被排除在外,因为现有记录分别包含 0 例和 3 例报告病例。将八种经过训练的模型(ARIMA、SARIMA、ETS、决策树、随机森林、梯度提升、LSTM 和时态 CNN)与朴素参考基线和移动平均参考基线进行了比较。目标年份划分使用 2024 年进行内部验证和模型选择,并使用 2025 年作为不合时宜的时间保留。当早期观察到的 2025 年病例数发生在相关预测原点之前时,允许将其作为预测 2025 年后期目标的因果输入。平均绝对误差是主要指标,由均方根误差、确定系数、特征重要性和 发病率 类误差分析支持。结果 清理后的数据集包含 417 个每周观察值和 8,263 个报告病例。尽管两周移动平均值和朴素基线产生的误差略低,但 ARIMA 是 2024 年内部验证期间训练最强的模型。在 2025 年的时间保留中,LSTM 实现了最有利的指标,MAE 为 7.951,RMSE 为 10.651,R2 为 0.698,其次是 ARIMA,MAE 为 8.652,RMSE 为 11.686,R2 为 0.636。两者的 MAE 均低于初始基线。基于树的模型主要依赖于当前的 发病率 和两周滚动摘要。所有评估的方法都倾向于低估 暴发 级别的周数。结论 在泄漏安全时间设计下,仅 监测 预测是可行的。LSTM 产生了最强的 2025 年保留指标,而 ARIMA 仍然是一个可解释且计算效率高的替代方案。操作使用应保留简单的基线,传达不确定性,并优先改进对 暴发 快速升级的检测。

papers.title: Dengue Vector Dynamics in India: Present and Future Multi-Model Suitability under SSP Scenarios Using a Machine Learning-Based Maximum Entropy Model
papers.abstract: Abstract Dengue Fever has emerged as an alarming climate-sensitive disease in India in recent time. This study examines the present and future climatic suitability of dengue transmission using a species distribution modelling (MaxEnt). High-resolution bioclimatic data of CHELSA v2.1 dataset (~ 1 km resolution) and georeferenced occurrence data of Aedes aegypti from various sources are used. Particular attention is given to data quality through spatial thinning, multicollinearity removal, and correction for sampling bias to improve model robustness. Future projections are generated using five General Circulation Models (GFDL-ESM4, IPSL-CM6A-LR, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MRI-ESM2-0, UKESM1-0-LL) under three Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP) (SSP126, SSP370, SSP585) across near (2011–2040), mid (2041–2070), and far-future (2071–2100) periods. The model has shown moderate predictive performance (AUC = 0.79, TSS = 0.53), while high Boyce Index (0.9) which is indicating strong ecological consistency in identifying suitable habitats. The results are clearly showing that more than half of India is climatically suitable for dengue transmission. Western Ghats, eastern coastal regions, and the northeastern states have higher suitability. Future projections are showing that changes are likely to occur through spatial redistribution rather than uniform expansion, which includes a gradual northward shift and localized reductions in suitability under high-emission scenarios. A comparison with reported dengue incidence further shows that substantial transmission is occuring even in areas categorised as moderately suitable, which shows that the higher suitability alone does not fully determine disease burden. Overall, the study highlights that dengue risk in India is not only a future concern but an ongoing challenge.

papers.title_zh: 印度的登革热 媒介 动态:使用基于机器学习的最大熵模型在 SSP 场景下当前和未来的多模型适用性
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Dengue Fever has emerged as an alarming climate-sensitive disease in India in recent time. This study examines the present and future climatic suitability of dengue transmission using a species distribution modelling (MaxEnt). High-resolution bioclimatic data of CHELSA v2.1 dataset (~ 1 km resolution) and georeferenced occurrence data of Aedes aegypti from various sources are used. Particular attention is given to data quality through spatial thinning, multicollinearity removal, and correction for sampling bias to improve model robustness. Future projections are generated using five General Circulation Models (GFDL-ESM4, IPSL-CM6A-LR, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MRI-ESM2-0, UKESM1-0-LL) under three Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSP) (SSP126, SSP370, SSP585) across near (2011–2040), mid (2041–2070), and far-future (2071–2100) periods. The model has shown moderate predictive performance (AUC = 0.79, TSS = 0.53), while high Boyce Index (0.9) which is indicating strong ecological consistency in identifying suitable habitats. The results are clearly showing that more than half of India is climatically suitable for dengue transmission. Western Ghats, eastern coastal regions, and the northeastern states have higher suitability. Future projections are showing that changes are likely to occur through spatial redistribution rather than uniform expansion, which includes a gradual northward shift and localized reductions in suitability under high-emission scenarios. A comparison with reported dengue incidence further shows that substantial transmission is occuring even in areas categorised as moderately suitable, which shows that the higher suitability alone does not fully determine disease burden. Overall, the study highlights that dengue risk in India is not only a future concern but an ongoing challenge.

papers.title: Molecular Characterization of DENV-1 Isolates From Pakistan Reveals Immunogenic Variability and Antiviral Potential of Phytochemicals Targeting the CprM Region.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV), a mosquito-borne arbovirus, remains a critical global health concern, causing approximately 390 million infections annually. Dengue fever poses significant challenges to healthcare systems in endemic regions like Pakistan due to the presence of four established serotypes (DENV-1-DENV-4) and the potential emergence of a fifth serotype (DENV-5). The current study aimed to investigate molecular characteristics of DENV-1 isolates from Peshawar, Pakistan, focusing on serotyping, genetic variability in the CprM junction region, and identification of potential antiviral phytochemicals. A total of 45 patient samples were screened, with the highest infection rate (49%) observed among individuals aged 20-40 years. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that six isolates clustered within the DENV-1 clade and grouped closely related to isolates from China, India, Bangladesh, and Pakistan, suggesting a regional evolution and potentially cross-border transmission. The prominent amino acid substitutions were Q47H, G48E, P49H, K51 E/N, L52 M, and M57I, which may influence viral structure, immune evasion, and antigenic properties. To address the lack of effective antivirals, a library of 60 phytochemicals was screened. Nine compounds demonstrated favorable ADMET profiles and high binding affinity (docking scores < -100) with the CprM region. Silydianin exhibited the strongest interaction (-159.81), indicating promising inhibitory potential. This integrative molecular and computational approach enhances our understanding of circulating DENV-1 strains and highlights plant-derived compounds as candidates for future antiviral development, pending in vitro validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革病毒 (DENV) 在全球造成大量发病,但有效的 抗病毒药物 仍然缺乏,特别是在多种血清型共同传播的巴基斯坦等流行地区。该研究解决了有关循环 DENV-1 分离株的分子特征及其对免疫和 抗病毒药物 发育的潜在影响的知识差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究筛查了来自巴基斯坦白沙瓦的 45 名患者样本,在 20-40 岁的个体中观察到感染率最高(49%)。它重点关注 DENV-1 分离株,检查血清分型、CprM 连接区域的遗传变异性以及植物化学物质的 抗病毒药物 潜力。
elements_zh.methods: 进行系统发育分析以评估 DENV-1 分离株的遗传变异性和区域 进化。针对 抗病毒药物 潜力筛选了 60 种植物化学物质的库,并使用对接分数和 ADMET 分析评估了与 CprM 区域的结合亲和力。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统发育分析发现了 6 个 DENV-1 分离株与来自中国、印度、孟加拉国和巴基斯坦的区域毒株紧密聚集。在 CprM 区域检测到 6 个氨基酸取代(Q47H、G48E、P49H、K51E/N、L52M、M57I)。九种植物化学物质对 CprM 区域表现出高结合亲和力(对接分数 < -100),其中水飞蓟宁表现出最强的相互作用(-159.81)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在 CprM 区域观察到的氨基酸取代可能会影响病毒结构、免疫逃避和抗原特性,突出了 抗病毒药物 设计的潜在目标。水飞蓟宁作为 CprM 区域高亲和力结合剂的鉴定代表了 DENV-1 抗病毒药物 开发的新计算线索。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过表征巴基斯坦循环的 DENV-1 变体为 监测 策略提供信息,并支持探索植物源化合物作为 抗病毒药物 疗法的候选药物,有待体外验证。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于其依赖于计算对接和计算机 ADMET 分析,而没有体外或体内验证,这限制了 抗病毒药物 功效的证据强度。小样本量(n = 45)和关注单一区域可能会限制系统发育和替代研究结果的普遍性。

papers.title: Molecular Detection of the -308 G/A Polymorphism in the Tumor Necrosis Factor Alpha (TNFα) Gene Promoter and Its Relationship with the Development of Severe Dengue in Patients from Urabá Subregion, Antioquia-Colombia
papers.abstract: Background: dengue fever is a viral infection caused by the Dengue Virus (DENV), a positive-sense RNA virus belonging to Flaviviridae family. The virus is transmitted to humans through the bite of the Aedes aegypti mosquito. Worldwide, between 100 and 400 million cases are reported annually. The infection in humans can cause three clinical forms which are related to severity: dengue without warnings signs, dengue with warnings signs, and severe dengue. Mutations in some genes that code for immune system proteins have been linked to the appearance of severe clinical forms of the disease, including TNF-α. The TNF-α plays a key role in the immunopathogenesis of the disease: mutations in this gene can increase the production of TNF-α, favoring cytokine storms and vascular damage, which is associated with severe clinical forms of the disease. Therefore, it is important to study the immunopathogenesis of the disease in the human to try to predict and control the onset of severe clinical forms and fatal cases. Methods: This study explores the link between TNF-α promoter gene polymorphism and dengue severity. We re-cruited 92 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases, including 30 dengue without warnings signs, 43 dengue with warnings signs, and 19 severe dengue. Genotyping was done using amplification by PCR (polymerase chain reaction), Sanger sequencing, and bio-informatics analysis of the TNF-α gene promoter mutations. A logistic regression assessed the association between -308 G/A TNF-α mutation and dengue severity. Results: the mutated genotype -308 G/A TNF-α was detected in 10.5% of severe cases. Interestingly, Severe cases showed higher odds of carrying the mutation than those without warnings signs. Severe cases were twice as likely to possess this mutation compared to those with warnings signs, however, no statistically significant differences were found. Genotype frequencies were consistent with Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium (p = 0.112). The estimated post hoc statistical power was 11.3%. Conclusions: Although no statistically significant association was detected, the TNF-α -308G/A polymorphism showed a trend toward increased susceptibility to severe dengue, with a higher frequency among severe cases than among patients with or without warnings signs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热 是由 登革病毒 (DENV) 引起的病毒感染,登革病毒 是黄病毒科的正链 RNA 病毒。人类感染可引起三种与严重程度相关的临床形式:无警告信号的登革热、有警告信号的登革热和 重症登革热。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究探讨了 TNF-α 启动子基因多态性与登革热严重程度之间的联系。我们重新招募了 92 例实验室确诊的登革热病例,其中 30 例没有警告标志的登革热病例、43 例有警告标志的登革热病例和 19 例 重症登革热。
elements_zh.methods: 通过 PCR(聚合酶链式反应)扩增、Sanger 测序和 TNF-α 基因启动子 突变 的生物信息学分析完成基因分型。逻辑回归评估了 -308 G/A TNF-α 突变 与登革热严重程度之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 在10.5%的重症病例中检测到突变基因型-308 G/A TNF-α。与有警告标志的患者相比,严重病例拥有这种 突变 的可能性是其两倍,但没有发现统计学上的显着差异。基因型频率与 Hardy-Weinberg 平衡一致 (p = 0.112)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 虽然没有检测到统计学上显着的关联,但 TNF-α -308G/A 多态性显示出对 重症登革热 的易感性增加的趋势,严重病例中的频率高于有或没有警告迹象的患者。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,TNF-α -308G/A 多态性可能是预测 重症登革热 的潜在生物标志物,这可以为未来对该疾病的免疫发病机制及其临床管理的研究提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 估计的事后统计功效为 11.3%,表明证据强度有限。该研究可能缺乏足够的样本量来检测显着的关联,因此应谨慎解释结果。

papers.title: Dengue virus rNS3pro immunization is associated with the expansion of regulatory-like T-cell phenotypes in BALB/c mice.
papers.abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) nonstructural protein 3 (NS3) is essential for viral replication and host immune evasion. While its protease domain (NS3pro) has been linked to T-cell anergy, its role in inducing regulatory T cells (Tregs) requires further exploration. To analyze the induction of diverse regulatory T-cell populations in BALB/c mice immunized with recombinant rNS3pro proteins from the four DENV serotypes. Mice were immunized with rNS3pro, and splenocytes were stimulated in vitro with homologous proteins. Cytokine expression and T-cell phenotypes-including markers for activation, exhaustion, and cytotoxicity-were analyzed via RT-PCR, ELISA, and flow cytometry. rNS3pro immunization induced a predominantly regulatory-associated response characterized by significant IL-10 expression. A marked expansion of CD4+CD25+ T cells (23.5% vs. 1.05% in controls) was observed, encompassing CD25+FoxP3+ regulatory-like T cells, alongside FoxP3-independent subsets expressing CD25+IL-10+ and CD25+TGF-β+. These cells co-expressed cytotoxicity-associated (FoxP3+Perforin+/GzB+) and co-inhibitory (CTLA-4+, PD-1+) markers. Effector CD8+ T-cell proliferation was significantly inhibited and could not be restored by exogenous IL-2. In conclusion, DENV rNS3pro immunization drives a robust expansion of multifaceted regulatory-like T-cell phenotypes. This immunomodulatory response correlates with compromised CD8+ effector proliferation, identifying the NS3 protease domain as a potential player in DENV immune evasion strategies.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to explore the role of Dengue virus (DENV) nonstructural protein 3 protease (NS3pro) in inducing regulatory-like T-cell responses, as its function in immune evasion and T-cell anergy is not fully understood.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved immunizing BALB/c mice with recombinant rNS3pro proteins from the four DENV serotypes and analyzing the resulting T-cell phenotypes in splenocytes stimulated in vitro with homologous proteins.
analysis.methods: Cytokine expression and T-cell phenotypes were assessed using RT-PCR, ELISA, and flow cytometry, focusing on markers of activation, exhaustion, cytotoxicity, and regulatory function.
analysis.main_results: rNS3pro immunization led to a significant expansion of CD4+CD25+ T cells, with 23.5% observed compared to 1.05% in controls. This included CD25+FoxP3+ regulatory-like T cells and FoxP3-independent subsets expressing CD25+IL-10+ and CD25+TGF-β+.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the immunomodulatory effects of Dengue virus (DENV) nonstructural protein 3 protease (NS3pro) in BALB/c mice. Cytokine expression and T-cell markers were assessed using RT-PCR, ELISA, and flow cytometry. The results showed a significant expansion of CD4+CD25+ T cells, including regulatory-like subsets expressing CD25+FoxP3+, CD25+IL-10+, and CD25+TGF-β+. The study's significance lies in its implications for understanding DENV's immune evasion strategies, which could inform vaccine development. However, the study is limited to in vitro analysis in mice, and the evidence is based on a single experiment, which may affect generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate.

elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,DENV rNS3pro 免疫诱导了类似调节的 T 细胞反应,这可能通过抑制效应 CD8+ T 细胞增殖来促进免疫逃避。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了对 DENV NS3pro 免疫调节机制的深入了解,这可以为 疫苗 的开发和增强 免疫应答 抗登革热的策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于 BALB/c 小鼠的体外分析,并且证据基于单个实验,这可能会影响普遍性。证据强度中等。

papers.title: Association of Pre-Existing Antithrombotic Therapy With Clinical Outcomes in Patients with Acute Dengue Infection.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue infection frequently causes thrombocytopenia and bleeding complications. Patients with cardiovascular disease who receive antiplatelet or anticoagulant therapy represent a clinically challenging population during acute dengue infection. Data regarding clinical outcomes and platelet recovery in these patients remain limited. METHODS: This observational study included a single-center retrospective cardiovascular dengue cohort and an exploratory platelet-monitoring cohort. In the retrospective cohort, patients were classified according to pre-existing antithrombotic therapy (ATT) at dengue diagnosis: no antithrombotic therapy (No ATT), single antiplatelet therapy (SAPT), dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT), or oral anticoagulant therapy (OAC). Major bleeding was assessed within 7 and 30 days after dengue diagnosis. In the exploratory platelet-monitoring cohort, serial platelet count and platelet function were assessed during dengue illness. RESULTS: The retrospective cohort included 1,693 patients (No ATT, n = 1,493; SAPT, n = 163; DAPT, n = 22; OAC, n = 15). ATT users were older and had a greater burden of cardiovascular comorbidities and more frequent severe dengue manifestations. The observed 7-day major bleeding rates in the No ATT, SAPT, DAPT, and OAC groups were 0.34%, 0.61%, 4.55%, and 6.67%, respectively (P = 0.011), with corresponding 30-day rates of 1.15%, 1.84%, 9.09%, and 13.33% (P = 0.002). In the exploratory platelet-monitoring cohort (6 non-antiplatelet users and 2 aspirin users), aspirin users had a longer platelet count nadir-to-recovery time than non-antiplatelet users [median (IQR), 7.5 (6.0-9.0) vs 4.0 (3.75-4.25) days; P = 0.04] and a longer interval from the lowest platelet function value to recovery [median (IQR), 9.5 (8.0-11.0) vs 4.0 (3.75-4.25) days; P = 0.04]. CONCLUSIONS: Pre-existing ATT users had a greater comorbidity burden and more severe dengue manifestations. SAPT users showed similar observed short-term major bleeding rates to patients without ATT. Exploratory monitoring suggested delayed platelet count and function recovery among aspirin users.

papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue infection frequently causes thrombocytopenia and bleeding complications. Patients with cardiovascular disease who receive antiplatelet or anticoagulant therapy represent a clinically challenging population during acute dengue infection. Data regarding clinical outcomes and platelet recovery in these patients remain limited. METHODS: This observational study included a single-center retrospective cardiovascular dengue cohort and an exploratory platelet-monitoring cohort. In the retrospective cohort, patients were classified according to pre-existing antithrombotic therapy (ATT) at dengue diagnosis: no antithrombotic therapy (No ATT), single antiplatelet therapy (SAPT), dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT), or oral anticoagulant therapy (OAC). Major bleeding was assessed within 7 and 30 days after dengue diagnosis. In the exploratory platelet-monitoring cohort, serial platelet count and platelet function were assessed during dengue illness. RESULTS: The retrospective cohort included 1,693 patients (No ATT, n = 1,493; SAPT, n = 163; DAPT, n = 22; OAC, n = 15). ATT users were older and had a greater burden of cardiovascular comorbidities and more frequent severe dengue manifestations. The observed 7-day major bleeding rates in the No ATT, SAPT, DAPT, and OAC groups were 0.34%, 0.61%, 4.55%, and 6.67%, respectively (P = 0.011), with corresponding 30-day rates of 1.15%, 1.84%, 9.09%, and 13.33% (P = 0.002). In the exploratory platelet-monitoring cohort (6 non-antiplatelet users and 2 aspirin users), aspirin users had a longer platelet count nadir-to-recovery time than non-antiplatelet users [median (IQR), 7.5 (6.0-9.0) vs 4.0 (3.75-4.25) days; P = 0.04] and a longer interval from the lowest platelet function value to recovery [median (IQR), 9.5 (8.0-11.0) vs 4.0 (3.75-4.25) days; P = 0.04]. CONCLUSIONS: Pre-existing ATT users had a greater comorbidity burden and more severe dengue manifestations. SAPT users showed similar observed short-term major bleeding rates to patients without ATT. papers.title: Metabolomic Approaches for the Identification of Non-Invasive Biomarkers in Dengue Infection: A Systematic Review
papers.abstract: Dengue is a major mosquito-borne viral disease whose rapid progression from self-limiting fever to hemorrhagic or shock syndrome (DHF/DSS) remains difficult to predict using conventional clinical markers. Metabolomics offers a promising avenue for identifying non-invasive biomarkers of infection and severity, but the evidence remains scattered across biofluids and analytical platforms. This systematic review synthesized human metabolomic studies of dengue infection to characterize the biofluids, techniques, and metabolic signatures reported to date. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, PubMed, ScienceDirect, and Web of Science were searched for studies applying NMR- or MS-based metabolomics to human dengue samples, screened against PECO criteria requiring a healthy-control or severity comparison group. Of 780 records identified, 17 studies met all eligibility criteria. Most studies (14/17) analyzed blood-derived matrices (serum, plasma, or whole blood), while three analyzed urine; no eligible study examined feces, saliva, tears, sweat, or cerebrospinal fluid. Across studies, three convergent patterns emerged with increasing disease severity: depletion of serotonin and related tryptophan-pathway metabolites, disturbance of glycerophospholipid and lysophospholipid classes, and elevation of markers of hepatic and lipid-metabolic stress (bile acids, VLDL/LDL changes, acylcarnitines). Serotonin combined with IFN-γ achieved the strongest discriminatory performance reported (AUC = 0.92) for progression to DHF, while urinary alkanes and betaine emerged as candidate non-invasive markers linked to infection status and comorbidities such as diabetes. These findings highlight a persistent reliance on blood-based sampling and a near-total absence of studies exploring alternative, more accessible biofluids, representing a clear gap for future non-invasive biomarker research in dengue.

papers.source_body_en: Dengue is a major mosquito-borne viral disease whose rapid progression from self-limiting fever to hemorrhagic or shock syndrome (DHF/DSS) remains difficult to predict using conventional clinical markers. papers.abstract_zh: 登革热是一种主要的蚊媒病毒性疾病,其从自限性发热到出血性或休克综合征 (DHF/DSS) 的快速进展仍然难以使用传统的临床标志物进行预测。代谢组学为识别感染和严重程度的非侵入性生物标志物提供了一种有前途的途径,但证据仍然分散在生物体液和分析平台中。本系统综述综合了登革热感染的人类代谢组学研究,以表征迄今为止报道的生物体液、技术和代谢特征。根据 PRISMA 2020 指南,对 PubMed、ScienceDirect 和 Web of Science 进行了搜索,以查找将基于 NMR 或 MS 的代谢组学应用于人类登革热样本的研究,并根据需要健康对照或严重程度对照组的 PECO 标准进行筛选。在确定的 780 项记录中,17 项研究符合所有资格标准。大多数研究 (14/17) 分析了血液基质(血清、血浆或全血),其中三项研究分析了尿液;没有符合条件的研究检查粪便、唾液、眼泪、汗液或脑脊液。研究发现,随着疾病严重程度的增加,出现了三种趋同模式:血清素和相关色氨酸途径代谢物的消耗,甘油磷脂和溶血磷脂类别的紊乱,以及肝脏和脂质代谢应激标志物的升高(胆汁酸、VLDL/LDL变化、酰基肉碱)。血清素与 IFN-γ 联合使用,在 DHF 进展方面取得了最强的判别性能(AUC = 0.92),而尿烷烃和甜菜碱则成为与感染状态和糖尿病等合并症相关的候选非侵入性标志物。这些发现凸显了对血液采样的持续依赖,并且几乎完全缺乏探索替代的、更容易获得的生物流体的研究,这代表了未来登革热非侵入性生物标志物研究的明显差距。

papers.title: 1-Year follow-up evaluation of TAK-003 dengue vaccine effectiveness against symptomatic disease and hospitalisation in adolescents during the 2024–2025 outbreak in São Paulo, Brazil: a test-negative case-control study
papers.abstract: Background Dengue is a growing global health threat. Our initial evaluation of the TAK-003 dengue vaccine in adolescents during the 2024 outbreak in São Paulo State, Brazil, showed short-term protection but suggested possible effectiveness waning after 90-days of the first dose, and had limited power to estimate second-dose effectiveness against hospitalisation. We evaluated 1-year vaccine effectiveness against symptomatic, virologically confirmed dengue and dengue hospitalisation in adolescents during 2024–2025, when DENV-1 and DENV-2 predominated in 2024 followed by increasing DENV-3 transmission in 2025. Methods We did a test-negative case–control study among adolescents aged 10–15 years in São Paulo State between Feb 20, 2024, and Dec 31, 2025. We extracted individual-level information on demographic characteristics, comorbidities, dengue testing, dengue vaccination, hospitalisation, and death during the study period from the national surveillance databases for dengue (SINAN-Dengue; compulsory notification) and the São Paulo State Secretary of Health vaccination registry (Rede Nacional de Dados em Saúde) on Feb 4, 2026. Cases were defined as acute febrile illness episodes with virologically confirmed dengue, as detected by NS1 antigen or RT-PCR testing within 5 days of symptom onset. Controls were test-negative acute febrile illness episodes. Surveillance data were linked to the state vaccination registry. Vaccine effectiveness after one or two TAK-003 doses was estimated with mixed-effects logistic regression. Findings We analysed 166,390 tests: 65,365 from cases and 101,025 from controls. Vaccine effectiveness against symptomatic dengue was 59.2% (95% CI 56.1–62.0) after one dose and 73.1% (69.1–76.6) after two doses. Against dengue hospitalisation, effectiveness was 74.6% (62.7–82.7) after one dose and 87.9% (73.0–94.6) after two doses. One-dose protection against symptomatic disease showed no evidence of waning over 1-year follow-up: effectiveness was 73.8% (64.7–80.6) at 270–364 days and 76.8% (59.3–86.8) at 365 days or more. Two-dose protection remained stable to 1 year (74.6%, 95% CI 59.0–84.2, at 270–365 days). Findings were robust in sensitivity analyses and comparable during increased DENV-3 circulation. Interpretation Our findings show that TAK-003 demonstrated sustained 1-year protection against symptomatic dengue and dengue hospitalisation in adolescents during a large outbreak. Notably, a single dose showed sustained effectiveness without evidence of waning over 1 year, generating an important hypothesis regarding dose reduction that warrants continued long-term observational evaluation. A second dose provided optimal protection, particularly against hospitalisation. These findings reinforce the importance of dengue vaccination as a public health measure. Funding National Council for Scientific and Technological Development.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the 1-year effectiveness of the TAK-003 dengue vaccine against symptomatic dengue and hospitalisation in adolescents during the 2024–2025 outbreak in São Paulo, Brazil. The research aimed to assess whether vaccine effectiveness waned over time and whether a single dose was sufficient. A test-negative case-control study design was used, analyzing 166,390 tests, including 65,365 from cases and 101,025 from controls. The results showed sustained effectiveness of one dose against symptomatic dengue (73.8% at 270–364 days and 76.8% at 365 days or more) and hospitalisation (74.6% at 270–365 days). Two-dose protection remained stable, with effectiveness against symptomatic dengue at 59.2% (95% CI 56.1–62.0) after one dose and 73.1% (69.1–76.6) after two doses. Against hospitalisation, effectiveness was 74.6% (62.7–82.7) after one dose and 87.9% (73.0–94.6) after two doses. The findings suggest that a single dose may provide sustained protection, generating a hypothesis about dose reduction that requires further evaluation. The study highlights the importance of dengue vaccination as a public health measure, particularly in outbreak settings. The evidence is robust and comparable across different virus strains, including DENV-3, which became more prevalent in 2025.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是一种日益严重的全球健康威胁。我们评估了 疫苗 在 2024 年至 2025 年期间对青少年有症状、病毒学确诊的登革热和登革热住院治疗的 1 年有效性,其中 DENV-1 和 DENV-2 在 2024 年占主导地位,随后在 2025 年增加了 DENV-3 传播。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们于2024年2月20日至2025年12月31日期间在圣保罗州的10-15岁青少年中进行了一项测试呈阴性的病例对照研究。我们对巴西圣保罗州2024年疫苗期间青少年中的TAK-003登革热疫苗进行了初步评估,显示出短期保护作用,但表明在第一次剂量的 90 天,并且评估第二次剂量对住院治疗的有效性的能力有限。
elements_zh.methods: 病例被定义为经病毒学证实的登革热急性发热性疾病发作,通过 NS1 抗原或 RT-PCR 检测在症状出现后 5 天内检测到。对照是测试阴性的急性发热性疾病发作。使用混合效应逻辑回归评估一剂或两剂 TAK-003 后 疫苗 的有效性。
elements_zh.main_results: 我们分析了 166,390 项测试:其中 65,365 项来自病例,101,025 项来自对照。疫苗 治疗一剂后对有症状登革热的有效性为 59.2%(95% CI 56.1-62.0),两剂后为 73.1%(69.1-76.6)。针对登革热住院治疗,接种一剂后的有效率为 74.6%(62.7-82.7),两剂后的有效性为 87.9%(73.0-94.6)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 单剂疫苗对有症状登革热的保护效果在1年随访期间未出现减弱迹象:在270–364天时为73.8%(64.7–80.6),在≥365天时为76.8%(59.3–86.8)。2剂疫苗的保护效果在1年内保持稳定(270–365天时为74.6%,95% CI 59.0–84.2)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强化了登革热 疫苗接种 作为公共卫生措施的重要性。敏感性分析的结果是稳健的,并且在 DENV-3 循环增加期间具有可比性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 我们的研究结果表明,TAK-003 在大 暴发 期间对青少年有症状的登革热和登革热住院治疗具有持续 1 年的保护作用。所提供的证据没有报告任何具体限制。

papers.abstract_zh: 背景 登革热正成为全球日益严重的公共卫生威胁。我们在2024年巴西圣保罗州登革热疫情期间对青少年人群开展的TAK-003登革疫苗初步评估显示,首剂疫苗可提供短期保护,但在首剂接种后90天可能出现保护效果减弱的迹象,且对第二剂疫苗在预防住院病例中的效果评估能力有限。本研究在2024–2025年期间评估TAK-003登革疫苗在青少年人群中对有症状、病毒学确认的登革热及登革热住院病例的1年保护效果。2024年主要流行DENV-1和DENV-2,2025年DENV-3流行逐渐增加。方法 本研究在巴西圣保罗州开展了一项病例对照研究,纳入年龄10–15岁的青少年,研究时间为2024年2月20日至2025年12月31日。我们于2026年2月4日从国家登革热监测数据库(SINAN-Dengue;强制报告)及圣保罗州卫生厅健康数据注册系统(Rede Nacional de Dados em Saúde)提取了研究期间个体的年龄、合并症、登革热检测、登革热疫苗接种史、住院及死亡信息。病例定义为急性发热疾病发作且在症状出现5天内通过NS1抗原或RT-PCR检测确认的登革热。对照为检测结果阴性的急性发热疾病发作。登革热疫苗接种史数据与州健康数据注册系统进行关联。TAK-003疫苗接种1剂或2剂后的保护效果通过混合效应逻辑回归进行评估。结果 共分析166,390份检测结果,其中65,365份来自病例,101,025份来自对照。TAK-003疫苗对有症状登革热的保护效果为:1剂后为59.2%(95% CI 56.1–62.0),2剂后为73.1%(69.1–76.6);对登革热住院病例的保护效果为:1剂后为74.6%(62.7–82.7),2剂后为87.9%(73.0–94.6)。1剂疫苗对有症状登革热的保护效果在1年随访期间未出现减弱迹象:在270–364天时为73.8%(64.7–80.6),在≥365天时为76.8%(59.3–86.8)。2剂疫苗的保护效果在1年内保持稳定(270–365天时为74.6%,95% CI 59.0–84.2)。敏感性分析结果稳健,且在DENV-3流行增加期间结果一致。结论 本研究结果表明,在大规模登革热疫情期间,TAK-003疫苗在青少年人群中可提供持续1年的有症状登革热及登革热住院保护。值得注意的是,单剂疫苗在1年内保护效果持续且未出现减弱迹象,为减少接种剂次这一重要假设提供了依据,有待进一步长期观察性评估。2剂疫苗可提供最佳保护效果,尤其是在预防住院病例方面。研究结果强调了登革热疫苗接种作为公共卫生措施的重要性。资助 国家科学技术发展委员会。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是一种日益严重的全球健康威胁。我们评估了 疫苗 在 2024 年至 2025 年期间对青少年有症状、病毒学确诊的登革热和登革热住院治疗的 1 年有效性,其中 DENV-1 和 DENV-2 在 2024 年占主导地位,随后在 2025 年增加了 DENV-3 传播。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们于2024年2月20日至2025年12月31日期间在圣保罗州的10-15岁青少年中进行了一项测试呈阴性的病例对照研究。我们对巴西圣保罗州2024年疫苗期间青少年中的TAK-003登革热疫苗进行了初步评估,显示出短期保护作用,但表明在第一次剂量的 90 天,并且评估第二次剂量对住院治疗的有效性的能力有限。
analysis_zh.methods: 病例被定义为经病毒学证实的登革热急性发热性疾病发作,通过 NS1 抗原或 RT-PCR 检测在症状出现后 5 天内检测到。对照是测试阴性的急性发热性疾病发作。使用混合效应逻辑回归评估一剂或两剂 TAK-003 后 疫苗 的有效性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 我们分析了 166,390 项测试:其中 65,365 项来自病例,101,025 项来自对照。疫苗 治疗一剂后对有症状登革热的有效性为 59.2%(95% CI 56.1-62.0),两剂后为 73.1%(69.1-76.6)。针对登革热住院治疗,接种一剂后的有效率为 74.6%(62.7-82.7),两剂后的有效性为 87.9%(73.0-94.6)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 单剂疫苗对有症状登革热的保护效果在1年随访期间未出现减弱迹象:在270–364天时为73.8%(64.7–80.6),在≥365天时为76.8%(59.3–86.8)。2剂疫苗的保护效果在1年内保持稳定(270–365天时为74.6%,95% CI 59.0–84.2)。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强化了登革热 疫苗接种 作为公共卫生措施的重要性。敏感性分析的结果是稳健的,并且在 DENV-3 循环增加期间具有可比性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 我们的研究结果表明,TAK-003 在大 暴发 期间对青少年有症状的登革热和登革热住院治疗具有持续 1 年的保护作用。所提供的证据没有报告任何具体限制。

papers.title: Dinamika Epidemiologi Demam Berdarah Dengue dalam Perspektif Kesehatan Masyarakat: Tren Satu Dekade dan Variabilitas Iklim di Nusa Tenggara Barat
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue hemorrhagic fever remains a pressing public health concern in tropical regions, although the influence of climatic factors varies across local settings. This study aims to describe the epidemiological patterns of dengue over a ten-year period in West Nusa Tenggara (NTB), Indonesia, and to examine its association with climate variability. Secondary annual data from 2015 to 2024 were analyzed, including dengue incidence, mortality, and case fatality rate (CFR), along with meteorological indicators such as average and maximum temperature, relative humidity, rainfall, number of rainy days, and duration of sunshine. Descriptive statistics were performed, followed by simple linear regression to explore potential relationships. Time series modeling was applied to assess predictive capacity. Dengue incidence ranged from 10.7 to 88.9 per 100,000 population (mean 51.7/100,000), with CFR consistently below 2%. Annual variations coincided with major disruptive events, including the 2018 earthquake and the COVID-19 pandemic. Linear regression analysis demonstrated consistent patterns: relative humidity showed a positive association with incidence (B ≈ +9.8, R2 up to 0.45, p = 0.071 when pandemic years were excluded), whereas average temperature and sunshine duration exhibited inverse relationships. Rainfall and number of rainy days showed weak and inconsistent associations. Time series analysis using Holt’s exponential smoothing captured short-term variability (stationary R2 = 0.82) but produced relatively high prediction error (MAPE 44%). In NTB, dengue incidence fluctuates annually and is influenced by climatic variability as well as extraordinary events such as earthquakes and the COVID-19 pandemic. Relative humidity appears to be the most consistent climatic determinant. Time series modeling reflects short-term trends but lacks precision, underscoring the importance of strengthening local surveillance systems. Keywords: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever, Climate Variability, Epidemiology, Humidity, West Nusa Tenggara. ABSTRAK Demam berdarah dengue masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat yang mendesak di wilayah tropis, namun pengaruh iklim bervariasi antar konteks lokal. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menggambarkan epidemiologi demam berdarah dengue selama satu dekade di Nusa Tenggara Barat (NTB), Indonesia, dan mengkaji hubungannya dengan variabilitas iklim. Data tahunan sekunder dari tahun 2015–2024 dianalisis, meliputi insiden demam berdarah, mortalitas, dan tingkat fatalitas kasus (CFR) beserta indikator meteorologi (suhu rata-rata dan maksimum, kelembapan relatif, curah hujan, hari hujan, dan durasi sinar matahari). Statistik deskriptif dilakukan, dilanjutkan dengan regresi linier sederhana untuk mengeksplorasi hubungan. Pemodelan deret waktu diterapkan untuk menilai potensi prediktif. Insiden dengue berkisar antara 10,7 dan 88,9 per 100.000 penduduk (rata-rata 51,7/100.000), dengan CFR secara konsisten di bawah 2%. Fluktuasi tahunan bertepatan dengan peristiwa anomali seperti gempa bumi tahun 2018 dan pandemi COVID-19. Regresi linier menunjukkan tren yang konsisten: kelembapan relatif berkorelasi positif dengan insiden (B ≈ +9,8, R2 hingga 0,45, p = 0,071 ketika tahun pandemi tidak termasuk), sementara suhu rata-rata dan durasi sinar matahari berkorelasi terbalik. Curah hujan dan hari hujan memberikan kontribusi asosiasi yang lemah dan tidak konsisten. Analisis deret waktu (pemulusan eksponensial Holt) menangkap variabilitas jangka pendek (R2 stasioner = 0,82) tetapi menunjukkan kesalahan prediksi yang tinggi (MAPE 44%). Di NTB, insiden demam berdarah berfluktuasi setiap tahun, dipengaruhi oleh variasi iklim serta kejadian luar biasa seperti gempa bumi dan wabah COVID-19. Kelembapan menunjukkan hubungan paling konsisten dengan insiden. Pemodelan deret waktu mencerminkan pola jangka pendek tetapi kurang presisi, sehingga menyoroti pentingnya sistem pengawasan lokal. Kata Kunci: Demam Berdarah, Perubahan Iklim, Epidemiologi, Kelembaban, Nusa Barat Tenggara.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述印度尼西亚西努沙登加拉省 (NTB) 十年间登革热的流行病学模式,并探讨其与气候变化的关系。尽管气候因素的影响因当地环境而异,但登革出血热仍然是热带地区紧迫的公共卫生问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 分析了2015年至2024年的二级年度数据,包括登革热发病率、死亡率和病死率(CFR),以及平均和最高温度、相对湿度、降雨量、雨天数和日照时数等气象指标。年度变化与重大破坏性事件同时发生,包括 2018 年地震和 COVID-19 大流行。
elements_zh.methods: 进行描述性统计,然后进行简单线性回归以探索潜在关系。应用时间序列模型来评估预测能力。
elements_zh.main_results: 登革热 发病率 范围为每 100,000 人 10.7 至 88.9 人(平均 51.7/100,000),病死率始终低于 2%。线性回归分析显示了一致的模式:相对湿度与 发病率 呈正相关(B ≈ +9.8,R2 高达 0.45,当排除大流行年份时,p = 0.071),而平均温度和日照时长则呈现负相关。降雨量和下雨天数显示出微弱且不一致的关联。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 相对湿度似乎是最一致的气候决定因素。时间序列建模反映了短期趋势,但缺乏精度,凸显了加强本地 监测 系统的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在 NTB,登革热 发病率 每年都会波动,并受到气候变化以及地震和 COVID-19 大流行等异常事件的影响。研究结果强调需要改进本地 监测 系统,以更好地监测和预测登革热 监测。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 使用 Holt 指数平滑的时间序列分析捕获了短期变异性(平稳 R2 = 0.82),但产生了相对较高的预测误差(MAPE 44%)。提供的证据未报告具体的统计功效或样本量计算。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述印度尼西亚西努沙登加拉省 (NTB) 十年间登革热的流行病学模式,并探讨其与气候变化的关系。尽管气候因素的影响因当地环境而异,但登革出血热仍然是热带地区紧迫的公共卫生问题。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 分析了2015年至2024年的二级年度数据,包括登革热发病率、死亡率和病死率(CFR),以及平均和最高温度、相对湿度、降雨量、雨天数和日照时数等气象指标。年度变化与重大破坏性事件同时发生,包括 2018 年地震和 COVID-19 大流行。
analysis_zh.methods: 进行描述性统计,然后进行简单线性回归以探索潜在关系。应用时间序列模型来评估预测能力。
analysis_zh.main_results: 登革热 发病率 范围为每 100,000 人 10.7 至 88.9 人(平均 51.7/100,000),病死率始终低于 2%。线性回归分析显示了一致的模式:相对湿度与 发病率 呈正相关(B ≈ +9.8,R2 高达 0.45,当排除大流行年份时,p = 0.071),而平均温度和日照时长则呈现负相关。降雨量和下雨天数显示出微弱且不一致的关联。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 相对湿度似乎是最一致的气候决定因素。时间序列建模反映了短期趋势,但缺乏精度,凸显了加强本地 监测 系统的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在 NTB,登革热 发病率 每年都会波动,并受到气候变化以及地震和 COVID-19 大流行等异常事件的影响。研究结果强调需要改进本地 监测 系统,以更好地监测和预测登革热 监测。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 使用 Holt 指数平滑的时间序列分析捕获了短期变异性(平稳 R2 = 0.82),但产生了相对较高的预测误差(MAPE 44%)。提供的证据未报告具体的统计功效或样本量计算。

papers.title: Dual readout RT-LAMP for rapid on-site dengue virus detection and serotyping
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue is the fastest-growing mosquito-borne disease, with over 14 million reported cases globally in 2024, rendering dengue a major public health issue of global concern. Fast and reliable serotype-specific diagnosis of dengue is critical for patient risk management and epidemiological surveillance. While real-time PCR currently remains the gold standard for dengue virus detection, it requires thermal cyclers and trained personnel in an established laboratory infrastructure, limiting its use in low-resource settings. Loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) offers a promising alternative, yet currently available reverse transcription assays for dengue either rely on limited sequences used for primer design, thus failing to adequately capture global genetic diversity, or use multiple primer sets, increasing complexity and costs. We developed four serotype-specific dengue virus (DENV) reverse transcription (RT)-LAMP assays in which primer design was informed by 4,277 whole-genome sequences from different geographical regions. Degenerate base positions were incorporated into primers to achieve broad detection capability while minimizing the number of distinct oligonucleotides needed. The assays achieved analytical sensitivities of 96–734 genome equivalents per reaction after 60 min. Clinical evaluation using 95 PCR-confirmed positive samples from Sri Lanka, including serotypes 1–3, demonstrated detection rates of 91.2% for DENV1, 78.6% for DENV2, and 100% for DENV3, with no cross-reactivity observed between serotypes. Evaluation using DENV4-spiked serum demonstrated reliable detection at clinically relevant viral loads, with complete detection at quantification cycle (Cq) values of ~30. A dual readout design enables both real-time fluorescence detection and equipment-free visual colorimetric detection, rendering the assays suitable for point-of-care applications in dengue-endemic regions worldwide. IMPORTANCE Dengue virus infections pose a growing threat to global health, with cases doubling annually since 2021, yet reliable diagnostic tools remain inaccessible in many affected regions. Current gold-standard molecular tests require expensive equipment and specialized laboratories, creating a critical gap in dengue-endemic areas where rapid, on-site diagnosis could save lives through early patient management and outbreak control. This study addresses this gap by developing dengue virus serotype-specific detection assays that work at a constant temperature without the need for sophisticated and expensive equipment. By analyzing thousands of dengue virus genome sequences and strategically incorporating degenerate bases, we designed primers that can detect diverse viral strains while maintaining simplicity and low cost. The assays provide results in 40–60 min, depending on the workflow, and can be read visually without instruments, making them practical for use in clinics, field settings, and resource-limited laboratories where dengue burden is highest.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a rapid, on-site dengue virus detection and serotyping method to address the limitations of current diagnostic tools. The researchers designed four serotype-specific RT-LAMP assays using 4,277 whole-genome sequences from different geographical regions, incorporating degenerate bases to ensure broad detection capability. Clinical evaluation of these assays using 95 PCR-confirmed positive samples from Sri Lanka showed high detection rates for DENV1, DENV2, and DENV3, with no cross-reactivity observed. papers.title: Dengue Fever in India at a Crossroads: Spatiotemporal Trends, Climate Change, and Vaccine Challenges in the Post-COVID Era
papers.abstract: Dengue fever is a major public health issue in India because its incidence and mortality rates vary with environmental, social, and infrastructural factors. There are not many effective vaccines yet, so the main treatments are supportive care, vector control, and surveillance. This study aimed to examine patterns in dengue cases and deaths across Indian states from 2023-2025, focusing on regional differences, the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and climate change, and the progress of vaccine development. Due to the COVID-19 pandemic, dengue cases in India remained a significant public health concern. In 2023, India reported 289,235 dengue cases and 485 deaths. In 2024, the number of reported cases declined to 233,519, with 297 deaths. As of 30 November 2025, 113,540 dengue cases and 95 deaths had been reported. Throughout this period, West Bengal, Maharashtra, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh, and Karnataka consistently recorded the highest dengue burden. Urbanization and climate change were two of the main reasons. There are still only a few vaccines to choose from, and it’s not clear how safe and effective the live-attenuated vaccines (Dengvaxia® and Qdenga). Dengue remains a growing and evolving threat in India. A comprehensive solution must encompass environmental management, vaccine research, public health monitoring, and climate change adaptation.
papers.journal: Journal of Pure and Applied Microbiology

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to examine patterns in dengue cases and deaths across Indian states from 2023-2025, focusing on regional differences, the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and climate change, and the progress of vaccine development. Dengue fever is a major public health issue in India because its incidence and mortality rates vary with environmental, social, and infrastructural factors.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed dengue cases and deaths across Indian states from 2023 to 2025. It focused on regional differences and the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and climate change on dengue trends. India reported 289,235 dengue cases and 485 deaths in 2023, with a decline to 233,519 cases and 297 deaths in 2024.
analysis.methods: The study used reported case and death data from Indian states over the period 2023-2025. It focused on analyzing regional differences and the effects of the pandemic and climate change on dengue trends. The data were sourced from public health records and analyzed for patterns and correlations.
analysis.main_results: In 2023, India reported 289,235 dengue cases and 485 deaths. In 2024, the number of reported cases declined to 233,519, with 297 deaths. As of 30 November 2025, 113,540 dengue cases and 95 deaths had been reported.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the persistent public health concern of dengue in India despite the pandemic. It underscores the need for a multifaceted approach to address the evolving threat of dengue.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the necessity of continued surveillance, environmental management, and vaccine research to mitigate the impact of dengue in India. They also emphasize the role of climate change in shaping dengue trends.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on reported data, which may be subject to underreporting or variability in surveillance practices. The evidence is moderate as it is based on observational data without experimental validation.

The study emphasizes the need for a multifaceted approach, including environmental management, vaccine research, and public health monitoring, to address the evolving threat of dengue. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在研究 2023 年至 2025 年印度各邦的登革热病例和死亡模式,重点关注区域差异、COVID-19 大流行和气候变化的影响以及 疫苗 的开发进展。登革热 是印度的一个重大公共卫生问题,因为其 发病率 和 死亡率 比率随环境、社会和基础设施因素而变化。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 2023 年至 2025 年印度各邦的登革热病例和死亡情况。研究重点是区域差异以及 COVID-19 大流行和气候变化对登革热趋势的影响。2023 年,印度报告了 289,235 例登革热病例和 485 例死亡,2024 年下降至 233,519 例病例和 297 例死亡。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用了 2023 年至 2025 年期间印度各邦报告的病例和死亡数据。它的重点是分析区域差异以及大流行和气候变化对登革热趋势的影响。数据来源于公共卫生记录,并分析其模式和相关性。
elements_zh.main_results: 2023年,印度报告了289,235例登革热病例,485人死亡。2024 年,报告病例数下降至 233,519 例,死亡 297 例。截至 2025 年 11 月 30 日,已报告 113,540 例登革热病例和 95 例死亡。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调了尽管登革热大流行,但印度对登革热的持续公共卫生担忧。它强调需要采取多方面的方法来应对不断变化的登革热威胁。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,有必要继续开展 监测、环境管理和 疫苗 研究,以减轻印度登革热的影响。他们还强调气候变化在塑造登革热趋势中的作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于报告的数据,这些数据可能会受到 监测 实践的漏报或变化的影响。证据是温和的,因为它基于未经实验验证的观察数据。

papers.title: Mapping Spatio-Temporal Hotspots of Dengue Transmission in Tasikmalaya, Indonesia.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND OBJECTIVES: Dengue is a major vector-borne disease in tropical and subtropical regions, including Indonesia, where recurrent outbreaks remain a significant public health concern. Understanding the spatial and temporal distribution of dengue transmission is essential for effective surveillance and targeted control strategies. This study aimed to map the spatio-temporal hotspots of dengue transmission in Tasikmalaya City, West Java, Indonesia, using Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and spatial statistical analysis. METHODS: Village-level spatial analyses were conducted using reported dengue cases from the complete calendar year of 2022 and 279 cases reported between January and September 2023. Of the 279 cases reported in 2023, 275 had valid residential coordinates and were included in the space-time cluster analysis. The space-time analysis was based on symptom onset dates ranging from 27 December 2022 to 30 September 2023. Global Moran's I, Local Indicators of Spatial Association (LISA), bivariate LISA, and the spatial scan statistic implemented in SaTScan were used to assess the spatial distribution and spatio-temporal clustering of dengue cases. RESULTS: Spatial clustering of dengue cases was identified in several urban villages, particularly around Cipedes and Tugujaya. Bivariate LISA revealed significant spatial co-occurrence between high dengue incidence and high population density. Spatio-temporal analysis detected three statistically significant clusters during 2023, indicating that dengue transmission was concentrated in specific geographic areas during distinct periods rather than being uniformly distributed over time. INTERPRETATION CONCLUSION: The findings highlight distinct spatio-temporal hotspots of dengue transmission and emphasize the role of population density and seasonal factors in shaping dengue risk. Spatial mapping and cluster detection can support targeted vector control and public health interventions.

papers.title: Epidemic Years Increase Hospitalization but Not Mortality Among Laboratory-Confirmed Dengue Cases in Mexico: A Nationwide Surveillance Study, 2020–2025
papers.abstract: Dengue is a major public health problem in Mexico, where large epidemics have occurred during recent years. Although demographic and clinical predictors of severe dengue have been widely studied, the impact of epidemic transmission periods on hospitalization and mortality remains poorly understood. This study evaluated the association between epidemic years and hospitalization and mortality among laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in Mexico. A nationwide retrospective analytical study was conducted using laboratory-confirmed dengue cases reported through the Mexican National Epidemiological Surveillance System between 2020 and 2025. Years were classified as epidemic (2023–2024) or non-epidemic (2020–2022 and 2025) according to official endemic channel analyses. Hospitalization and mortality were evaluated as primary outcomes. Multivariable logistic regression models were developed to identify factors independently associated with hospitalization and mortality. A total of 235,226 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases were included, of whom 90,661 (38.5%) were hospitalized and 1604 (0.68%) died. Overall, 170,819 cases (72.6%) occurred during epidemic years. Hospitalization was more frequent during epidemic years than during non-epidemic years (40.2% vs. 34.1%; crude OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.27–1.32; p < 0.001), whereas mortality did not differ significantly (0.68% vs. 0.69%; crude OR 0.99, 95% CI 0.89–1.11; p = 0.919). In multivariable analysis, epidemic-year status remained independently associated with hospitalization (aOR 1.26, 95% CI 1.24–1.29; p < 0.001) but not with mortality (aOR 1.00, 95% CI 0.90–1.12; p = 0.946). Chronic kidney disease showed the strongest independent association with both hospitalization (aOR 5.36, 95% CI 4.33–6.65) and mortality (aOR 6.98, 95% CI 5.23–9.32). Advanced age and other underlying comorbidities were also independently associated with adverse outcomes. Epidemic years were associated with increased hospitalization among laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in Mexico but were not associated with increased mortality. Mortality was more strongly associated with age and underlying comorbidities, particularly chronic kidney disease. These findings highlight the importance of strengthening hospital preparedness during epidemic periods while prioritizing clinical monitoring of high-risk patients.

papers.title_zh: 墨西哥实验室确诊的登革热病例中,流行年增加了住院治疗,但 死亡率 没有增加:2020-2025 年全国 监测 研究
papers.source_body_en: Dengue is a major public health problem in Mexico, where large epidemics have occurred during recent years. Although demographic and clinical predictors of severe dengue have been widely studied, the impact of epidemic transmission periods on hospitalization and mortality remains poorly understood. This study evaluated the association between epidemic years and hospitalization and mortality among laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in Mexico. A nationwide retrospective analytical study was conducted using laboratory-confirmed dengue cases reported through the Mexican National Epidemiological Surveillance System between 2020 and 2025. Years were classified as epidemic (2023–2024) or non-epidemic (2020–2022 and 2025) according to official endemic channel analyses. Hospitalization and mortality were evaluated as primary outcomes. Multivariable logistic regression models were developed to identify factors independently associated with hospitalization and mortality. A total of 235,226 laboratory-confirmed dengue cases were included, of whom 90,661 (38.5%) were hospitalized and 1604 (0.68%) died. Overall, 170,819 cases (72.6%) occurred during epidemic years. Hospitalization was more frequent during epidemic years than during non-epidemic years (40.2% vs. 34.1%; crude OR 1.30, 95% CI 1.27–1.32; p < 0.001), whereas mortality did not differ significantly (0.68% vs. 0.69%; crude OR 0.99, 95% CI 0.89–1.11; p = 0.919). In multivariable analysis, epidemic-year status remained independently associated with hospitalization (aOR 1.26, 95% CI 1.24–1.29; p < 0.001) but not with mortality (aOR 1.00, 95% CI 0.90–1.12; p = 0.946). Chronic kidney disease showed the strongest independent association with both hospitalization (aOR 5.36, 95% CI 4.33–6.65) and mortality (aOR 6.98, 95% CI 5.23–9.32). Advanced age and other underlying comorbidities were also independently associated with adverse outcomes. Epidemic years were associated with increased hospitalization among laboratory-confirmed dengue cases in Mexico but were not associated with increased mortality. Mortality was more strongly associated with age and underlying comorbidities, particularly chronic kidney disease. These findings highlight the importance of strengthening hospital preparedness during epidemic periods while prioritizing clinical monitoring of high-risk patients.

papers.title: Dengue Virus Molecular Targets and Antiviral Drug Development: Advances, Challenges and Therapeutic Perspectives
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue is the most prevalent arboviral disease in tropical and subtropical regions, with over 13 million cases recorded in the Americas in 2024. Despite its enormous public health impact, no specific antiviral therapy is currently approved for dengue virus (DENV). In this context, this narrative review critically analyses the principal molecular targets of DENV, including structural proteins (C, prM/M and E), nonstructural proteins (NS1–NS5) and host factors, with emphasis on the development of small‐molecule antivirals and an evaluation of their progress in pre‐clinical and clinical studies. The NS2B–NS3 protease complex and NS5 (both RdRp and MTase domains) remain the most extensively explored targets, owing to the availability of high‐resolution crystal structures and higher inter‐serotype conservation. NS4B has emerged as the most clinically advanced target. Among direct‐acting antivirals, AT‐752 was also discontinued due to low viraemia at enrolment, while NITD‐688 remains among the most advanced pipeline molecules. Host‐directed therapies including anakinra and baricitinib are under clinical investigation for severe dengue. Key translational challenges include viral serotype diversity, pharmacokinetic limitations, cytotoxicity, and the timing of treatment initiation relative to viral kinetics. Advances in rational drug design, drug repurposing, allosteric inhibition, and targeted protein degradation (PROTACs) offer renewed perspectives for effective dengue therapeutics.
authors: Aryane Lucia da Silva Aguiar De Oliveira
Marcelo Arthur Dias da Costa Santana

source_records.abstract: ABSTRACT Dengue is the most prevalent arboviral disease in tropical and subtropical regions, with over 13 million cases recorded in the Americas in 2024. Despite its enormous public health impact, no specific antiviral therapy is currently approved for dengue virus (DENV). In this context, this narrative review critically analyses the principal molecular targets of DENV, including structural proteins (C, prM/M and E), nonstructural proteins (NS1–NS5) and host factors, with emphasis on the development of small‐molecule antivirals and an evaluation of their progress in pre‐clinical and clinical studies. The NS2B–NS3 protease complex and NS5 (both RdRp and MTase domains) remain the most extensively explored targets, owing to the availability of high‐resolution crystal structures and higher inter‐serotype conservation. NS4B has emerged as the most clinically advanced target. Among direct‐acting antivirals, AT‐752 was also discontinued due to low viraemia at enrolment, while NITD‐688 remains among the most advanced pipeline molecules. Host‐directed therapies including anakinra and baricitinib are under clinical investigation for severe dengue. Key translational challenges include viral serotype diversity, pharmacokinetic limitations, cytotoxicity, and the timing of treatment initiation relative to viral kinetics. Advances in rational drug design, drug repurposing, allosteric inhibition, and targeted protein degradation (PROTACs) offer renewed perspectives for effective dengue therapeutics.

It highlights the NS2B–NS3 protease complex and NS5 as the most extensively studied targets due to their structural availability and conservation across serotypes. NS4B is noted as the most clinically advanced target. The review underscores the need for further research and development to address these challenges and improve therapeutic options for dengue.

papers.title: Prevalence of Severe Dengue Infection in Bangladesh: A Bayesian Meta-analysis
papers.abstract: Severe dengue represents a critical and potentially life-threatening stage of dengue infection, often characterizes by internal bleeding which leads to death. Several studies existed on severe dengue but a meta-analysis can provide robust understanding of the epidemiology of the disease. This study aimed to estimate the pooled prevalence of dengue cases which developed to severe dengue in Bangladesh. A systematic literature search was conducted across five databases between January 2000 and June 2025: PubMed, Google Scholar, Cochrane Central, Science Direct, and BanglaJOL. After title and abstract screening and full text review, this study included 41 cross-sectional studies. The quality of included studies were assessed using the STROBE checklist. Bayesian random-effects model was applied to estimate the pooled prevalence, with both non-informative and informative priors. Further, model diagnostics including trace plots and autocorrelation checks were used to assess MCMC convergence. A Bayesian random-effects model using the strongly informative prior estimated a pooled prevalence of 33.9% (95% Credible Interval: 25.4, 42.0), and a between-study heterogeneity () of 0.074. Model diagnostics were further supported these findings by the evidence of adequate mixing and convergence, with no signs of autocorrelation in the MCMC chains. However, this study have found one-third of the dengue cases developed to severe dengue cases which indicates a serious burden for the healthcare system of the country. These findings have important implications for public health surveillance and can inform policymakers in planning and prioritizing interventions to manage severe dengue cases in Bangladesh. 74(2): 301–310, 2026 (July)

papers.title_original: Prevalence of Severe Dengue Infection in Bangladesh: A Bayesian Meta-analysis

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the prevalence of severe dengue infection in Bangladesh, focusing on the proportion of dengue cases progressing to severe dengue, a life-threatening stage characterized by internal bleeding and potential fatality.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review conducted a systematic literature search across five databases (PubMed, Google Scholar, Cochrane Central, Science Direct, and BanglaJOL) from January 2000 to June 2025, identifying 41 cross-sectional studies. Study quality was assessed using the STROBE checklist, and a Bayesian random-effects model with both non-informative and informative priors was applied to estimate pooled prevalence.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled prevalence of severe dengue among dengue cases in Bangladesh was estimated at 33.9% (95% Credible Interval: 25.4, 42.0), with a between-study heterogeneity (τ2) of 0.074. Model diagnostics confirmed adequate mixing and convergence of MCMC chains, with no signs of autocorrelation.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review does not report the geographic or temporal distribution of included studies, limiting insights into regional or seasonal variations in severe dengue prevalence. Additionally, the reliance on cross-sectional studies may introduce selection bias, and the use of a Bayesian model with informative priors could influence pooled estimates.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The high pooled prevalence of severe dengue (33.9%) underscores a significant burden on Bangladesh's healthcare system, necessitating targeted public health surveillance and resource allocation. Policymakers should prioritize interventions to manage severe dengue cases, including early diagnosis and treatment strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This review estimates that approximately one-third of dengue cases in Bangladesh progress to severe dengue, a life-threatening condition marked by internal bleeding. Using a Bayesian meta-analysis of 41 cross-sectional studies identified through a systematic search of five databases (2000–2025), the pooled prevalence of severe dengue was 33.9% (95% Credible Interval: 25.4–42.0), with low between-study heterogeneity (τ2 = 0.074). Model diagnostics confirmed robust convergence and mixing of Markov Chain Monte Carlo simulations. The findings highlight a substantial healthcare burden, emphasizing the need for enhanced surveillance and targeted interventions to mitigate severe dengue outcomes in Bangladesh.

papers.title: Meteorological drivers and short-term prediction of dengue fever in a tropical region of China: evidence from Hainan Province
papers.abstract: Objective Meteorological factors influence dengue transmission through nonlinear and lagged effects. This study assessed these associations in Hainan Province and developed an early risk prediction index. Methods Weekly dengue case and meteorological data from Hainan Province (2018–2019 and 2023–2024) were analyzed using distributed lag non-linear models (DLNMs). An early risk prediction index(ERPI) was constructed from DLNM-derived cumulative meteorological risk signals and imported cases. Predictive performance was evaluated using leave-one-year-out cross-validation and assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC), sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV). Results Among 927 dengue cases reported during the four modelled years, 727 (78.43%) were locally acquired. Weekly mean daily maximum temperature (Tmax), precipitation (Pmean), wind speed (WSmean), and diurnal temperature range (DTRmean) showed nonlinear, lag-dependent associations with dengue risk, with distinct temporal patterns. Higher Tmax showed longer-lag effects, peaking at 33.73 °C at lag 8 weeks ( RR = 2.45, 95% CI: 1.70–3.63). Its cumulative effect was strongest over lags 5–8 weeks, peaking at approximately 32 °C. Pmean showed a nonlinear association, peaking at 4 mm/day at a lag of 4 weeks ( RR = 1.92, 95% CI: 1.59–2.31), with significant cumulative effect across both the 1–4- and 5–8-week windows. Low WSmean and moderate DTRmean showed their strongest cumulative associations over lags 1–4 weeks, peaking at 2.0 m/s and 6.1 °C, respectively. These harmful associations attenuated over lags 5–8 weeks, whereas higher WSmean and DTRmean were generally protective. The ERPI predicted local dengue occurrence within the subsequent 1–4-week windows, with AUCs of 0.762–0.843. Across these windows, sensitivities were 0.768–0.797, specificities were 0.644–0.708, PPVs were 0.468–0.624, and NPVs were 0.822–0.911. Conclusion In Hainan, high temperature was primarily associated with medium-to-long-term dengue risk, whereas low-to-moderate diurnal temperature range increased short-term risk. Precipitation was associated with risk across both short and medium-to-long lags, while cumulative wind-speed associations were strongest over shorter lags and attenuated thereafter. The DLNM-based early risk prediction index may support meteorology-informed early warning and dengue control in tropical settings, although requiring external validation is needed before operational implementation.

analysis.methods: Distributed lag non-linear models (DLNMs) were used to analyze the data, and an early risk prediction index (ERPI) was constructed from cumulative meteorological risk signals and imported cases.

analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that high temperature was primarily associated with medium-to-long-term dengue risk, while low-to-moderate diurnal temperature range increased short-term risk, highlighting the complex relationship between climate factors and dengue transmission.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the influence of meteorological factors on dengue transmission in Hainan Province, China, using distributed lag non-linear models (DLNMs) and an early risk prediction index (ERPI). The research highlights nonlinear and lagged effects of temperature, precipitation, wind speed, and diurnal temperature range on dengue risk, with higher temperatures linked to medium-to-long-term risk and lower diurnal temperature ranges associated with short-term risk. The ERPI demonstrated predictive performance with AUCs of 0.762–0.843, sensitivities of 0.768–0.797, and NPVs of 0.822–0.911. However, the study's findings require external validation for operational use, indicating moderate confidence in their application for public health interventions.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在调查气象因素如何通过非线性和滞后效应影响登革热 传播,满足了解这些动态以改进早期预警系统的需要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了2018-2019年和2023-2024年中国海南省的每周登革热病例和气象数据,重点关注天气变量与登革热风险之间的关联。
elements_zh.methods: 采用分布式滞后非线性模型(DLNM)对数据进行分析,并根据累积的气象风险信号和输入病例构建早期风险预测指数(ERPI)。
elements_zh.main_results: 在四个模拟年份报告的 927 例登革热病例中,727 例(78.43%)是本地感染。周平均每日最高气温 (Tmax)、降水量 (Pmean)、风速 (WSmean) 和昼夜温差 (DTRmean) 与登革热风险呈非线性、滞后相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,高温主要与中长期登革热风险相关,而中低至中等昼夜温度范围则增加了短期风险,凸显了气候因素与登革热之间的复杂关系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,将气象数据纳入预警系统可以加强热带地区的登革热控制,为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施提供基础。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的结果基于观察数据,在实施之前需要外部验证,表明对预测模型的实用性有一定的信心。

papers.title: Applying AI Embodied Deep Learning Models for Real‐Time Prediction and Classification of Dengue Virus Serotypes Using Complete Genome Data
papers.abstract: Designed for the serotype categorization and sequence generation of Dengue Virus (DE VI ), using whole genome data, this study presents an AI embodied deep learning system, AIemDL DVE . We constructed unified datasets using processed 2000 genome sequences and built an LSTM-based generative model capable of identifying distinct characteristics in DE VI sequences. Comparative analysis of GRU, 1 Dimensional convolutional analysis (1D-Con), and Simple RNN models found that the LSTM model produced sequences surpassing 10 kb with great precision, therefore revealing its improved performance. With a feed-forward neural network (FNN), we categorized with an F1 score of 99% and validation accuracy of 98.12%. Moreover, motif analysis underscored conserved genetic components using the MEME Suite highlighted, which enhances model interpretability. Although it is most pertinent to similar-sized genomes, our AIemDL DVE method provides reliable predictions that might help DE VI -related vaccine research and diagnostics. This work demonstrates how effectively AI embodied deep learning may improve viral sequence classification and support knowledge of viral evolution and spread.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to develop an AI embodied deep learning system for real-time prediction and classification of Dengue Virus (DE VI) serotypes using complete genome data, addressing the need for improved methods in viral sequence analysis and understanding of viral evolution.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved constructing unified datasets using processed 2000 genome sequences of Dengue Virus and building an LSTM-based generative model to identify distinct characteristics in these sequences.
analysis.methods: The researchers used a feed-forward neural network (FNN) for categorization and compared different models, including GRU, 1 Dimensional convolutional analysis (1D-Con), and Simple RNN, to evaluate performance based on sequence generation and classification accuracy.
analysis.main_results: The LSTM model generated sequences surpassing 10 kb with great precision, and the FNN achieved an F1 score of 99% and validation accuracy of 98.12% in categorizing Dengue Virus sequences.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the enhanced interpretability of the AIemDL DVE method through motif analysis, which identified conserved genetic components using the MEME Suite, offering a novel approach to viral sequence classification.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that the AIemDL DVE method could support vaccine research and diagnostics for Dengue Virus, providing reliable predictions that may aid in understanding viral evolution and spread.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's results are based on a single dataset of 2000 sequences, which may limit generalizability, and the evidence is limited to abstract-level reporting, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces an AI embodied deep learning system, AIemDL DVE, for real-time prediction and classification of Dengue Virus serotypes using complete genome data. The researchers constructed unified datasets from 2000 processed Dengue Virus sequences and developed an LSTM-based generative model. Comparative analysis showed that the LSTM model produced sequences exceeding 10 kb with high precision, while a feed-forward neural network (FNN) achieved an F1 score of 99% and validation accuracy of 98.12% in categorization. Motif analysis using the MEME Suite revealed conserved genetic components, enhancing model interpretability. The method's reliability could aid in vaccine research and diagnostics for Dengue Virus, offering insights into viral evolution and spread. However, the study's findings are based on a single dataset, which may limit generalizability, and the evidence is abstract-level, resulting in moderate confidence in the results.

papers.title: Tinjauan Pelaksanaan Surveilans Dengue Haemorrhagic Fever Rawat Inap di Rumah Sakit Marinir Cilandak
papers.abstract: In 2022, Indonesia recorded a total of 131,265 Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) cases, with 40% occurring in children aged 0-14 years. Preliminary observations conducted in December 2022 at Cilandak Marine Hospital revealed that while surveillance was performed daily, it was frequently delayed. Reporting lags in data collection were attributed to limited human resources, as there was only one dedicated staff member who was frequently assigned to external duties. This study employs a qualitative descriptive method to illustrate the implementation of the DHF surveillance system at Cilandak Marine Hospital. Results from observations and interviews with medical record officers indicate that there is no Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for DHF surveillance. Data analysis regarding the timeliness of reporting for hospitalized DHF patients showed a rate of only 7.6% (out of 13 patients) in March, compared to 50% (out of 4 patients) in October. Furthermore, daily attendance for active hospital surveillance was recorded at only 3.3% in March 2023 and 6.5% in October, indicating low compliance with surveillance performance indicators. Timeliness in data collection and submission is critical as an early warning indicator to prevent the widespread transmission of dengue and the occurrence of outbreaks (Extraordinary Events).
papers.journal: Detector: Jurnal Inovasi Riset Ilmu Kesehatan

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted at Cilandak Marine Hospital in December 2022 and March/October 2023, focusing on hospitalized DHF patients and the daily surveillance practices implemented there.
analysis.methods: The study used a qualitative descriptive method involving observations and interviews with medical record officers to assess the implementation of DHF surveillance and identify challenges in data collection and reporting.
analysis.main_results: Preliminary observations revealed that surveillance was frequently delayed, with no Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for DHF surveillance. Data analysis showed a reporting timeliness rate of 7.6% in March (out of 13 patients) and 50% in October (out of 4 patients).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the lack of standardized procedures and low compliance with surveillance performance indicators, indicating a need for improved systems to ensure timely data collection and reporting.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results emphasize the importance of timely data collection and submission for early warning and outbreak prevention, which can inform better surveillance strategies in dengue-endemic areas.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to observations and interviews, which may introduce bias. The evidence is moderate as it provides insights into surveillance practices but lacks quantitative data on broader impacts.

Data analysis showed a reporting timeliness rate of 7.6% in March 2023 and 50% in October 2023, indicating inconsistent adherence to surveillance performance indicators. The findings suggest the need for improved systems to ensure timely data collection and reporting, which is critical for early warning and outbreak prevention. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估医院中登革热出血热 (DHF) 监测 的实施情况,以解决登革热疾病的公共卫生问题,登革热疾病是发病率和 监测 的重要原因,特别是在儿童中。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究于 2022 年 12 月和 2023 年 3 月/10 月在 Cilandak 海洋医院进行,重点关注住院 DHF 患者以及那里实施的日常 监测 实践。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究采用定性描述方法,包括观察和采访病历官员,以评估 DHF 监测 的实施情况,并确定数据收集和报告方面的挑战。
elements_zh.main_results: 初步观察显示,监测 经常延误,且没有针对 DHF 监测 的标准操作程序 (SOP)。数据分析显示,3 月份(13 名患者)的报告及时率为 7.6%,10 月份(4 名患者)的报告及时率为 50%。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 调查结果强调了缺乏标准化程序以及对 监测 绩效指标的遵守率低,这表明需要改进系统以确保及时的数据收集和报告。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调了及时收集和提交数据对于早期预警和 监测 预防的重要性,这可以为登革热流行地区更好的 监测 策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于观察和访谈,这可能会引入偏差。证据是中等的,因为它提供了对 监测 实践的见解,但缺乏更广泛影响的定量数据。

papers.source_body_en: In 2022, Indonesia recorded a total of 131,265 Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) cases, with 40% occurring in children aged 0-14 years. Preliminary observations conducted in December 2022 at Cilandak Marine Hospital revealed that while surveillance was performed daily, it was frequently delayed. Reporting lags in data collection were attributed to limited human resources, as there was only one dedicated staff member who was frequently assigned to external duties. This study employs a qualitative descriptive method to illustrate the implementation of the DHF surveillance system at Cilandak Marine Hospital. Results from observations and interviews with medical record officers indicate that there is no Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for DHF surveillance. Data analysis regarding the timeliness of reporting for hospitalized DHF patients showed a rate of only 7.6% (out of 13 patients) in March, compared to 50% (out of 4 patients) in October. Furthermore, daily attendance for active hospital surveillance was recorded at only 3.3% in March 2023 and 6.5% in October, indicating low compliance with surveillance performance indicators. Timeliness in data collection and submission is critical as an early warning indicator to prevent the widespread transmission of dengue and the occurrence of outbreaks (Extraordinary Events).

papers.title: Longitudinal changes in platelet indices during recovery from dengue fever: A prospective observational study
papers.abstract: Background: Dengue fever, caused by the flavivirus, is a major health problem in tropical regions. Severe infection presents with thrombocytopenia, hemoconcentration, and bleeding manifestations. Platelet indices, including mean platelet volume (MPV), platelet distribution width (PDW), plateletcrit (PCT), platelet large cell count (P-LCC), and platelet large cell ratio (P-LCR), have been proposed as potential markers of disease activity in dengue fever; however, their longitudinal behavior remains uncertain. Aims and Objectives: This study was undertaken to determine and assess the role of different platelet indices (MPV, PDW-standard deviation, PDW-coefficient of variation, P-LCC, P-LCR) in dengue fever and to determine the correlation between the clinical course and outcome of dengue fever with the platelet indices. Materials and Methods: This prospective study included 53 serologically confirmed dengue patients over 6 months. Clinical data were collected. Platelet count, MPV, PDW, PCT, P-LCC, P-LCR, and hematocrit (HCT) were measured at 12-h intervals. Repeated measures analysis and linear mixed-effects modeling evaluated longitudinal trends. Logistic regression and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis assessed the association and predictive performance for moderate/poor clinical conditions. Results: The study included 42 males (79.2%), 11 females (20.8%), with mean age of 32.1 years. Most cases were of dengue without warning signs as per the World Health Organization 2009 classification. Platelet counts increased during hospitalization (P<0.001). MPV demonstrated an upward trend over time (β=0.542 fL/day, P<0.001). Higher MPV was associated with lower odds of moderate/poor clinical condition (odds ratio 0.68, P=0.017). However, ROC analysis showed limited standalone discriminative ability (area under the curve=0.33). PDW, P-LCC, and P-LCR showed recovery-phase increases, while HCT declined. Conclusion: Platelet indices demonstrate significant dynamic changes during recovery from dengue and may serve as adjunct markers of hematological regeneration. However, their independent predictive accuracy for clinical severity requires validation in larger cohorts.
